item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-6160945d2e8fa932","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 17 July 2023, Félix Tshisekedi chaired a security meeting for the Kinshasa Francophonie Games, sought zero incidents, instructed authorities to secure the event, and ordered creation of a mixed army-police mobile patrol across Kinshasa and its outskirts, with an operational coordination mechanism to implement the decision.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source reports a presidential directive and planned implementation, but no outcome or independent assessment.","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency attributes the instructions and patrol decision directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["Official presidential account; no reported incident statistics, enforcement record, or independent evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6bf03cb8e582c0a4","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"During 2023, the M23 conflict continued in eastern DRC: an Angola-announced ceasefire was scheduled for 7 March and broadly held until early October, sporadic clashes continued, fierce fighting resumed in North Kivu in October, Kinshasa alleged a new Rwandan incursion based on drone imagery, and MONUSCO and FARDC announced Operation Springbok on 3 November to prevent M23 from taking Goma.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.10","3B.6","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 conflict developments; the article also provides prior-period context.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes ceasefire diplomacy and Kinshasa's allegations and military responses to the DRC authorities; it does not establish Tshisekedi's personal role in every operational decision.","limitations":["Chronological secondary report; claims about Rwandan involvement and drone imagery are presented as allegations, not independently adjudicated findings."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6bf03cb8e582c0a4","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 3 November 2022, Tshisekedi called on Congolese youth to organize into vigilance groups and enlist massively in the army in response to the M23 conflict.","question_ids":["2B.2","3B.2","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The event predates 2023 and is included only as relevant inherited crisis context; it does not establish a 2023 action.","ruler_attribution":"The source directly attributes the call to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["Outside the target year; no evidence here of the groups' conduct or subsequent implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-95489f8b4b424745","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 7 March 2023, Tshisekedi met nine newly appointed members of Gécamines' board and management team, received their plan to redynamize the state mining company, and gave orientations emphasizing good management of the national mining patrimony for the population.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.2","5B.6","8B.2","8B.4"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source documents appointments, a plan, and presidential guidance, but not implementation or results.","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency attributes the appointments to presidential ordinances and the orientations to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["Official account; it does not provide appointment criteria, procurement safeguards, executed resources, or performance outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9ca5736caa99a983","start_unit":1,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The CIA's 31 March 2023 leadership archive lists Tshisekedi as president and identifies the serving prime minister, vice prime ministers, ministers, and Central Bank governor, including portfolios for defense, interior, finance, budget, justice, human rights, mines, health, education, and social affairs.","question_ids":["5B.2","6B.4","8B.4"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Leadership snapshot dated 31 March 2023; it establishes officeholders but not their competence, independence, or performance.","ruler_attribution":"The archive records the government serving under Tshisekedi but does not attribute each appointment decision to him.","limitations":["Institutional roster only; no appointment process, resource, implementation, or outcome evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d4768ce88582bb91","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 7 October 2023, Tshisekedi filed his candidacy with CENI for a second five-year presidential term, stating that the Constitution permitted the bid, praising his record, arguing that the country was emerging from a prior crisis, and calling economic independence the current struggle.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.8","5B.1","8B.1"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source records a candidacy and campaign claims, not verified outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency directly attributes the candidacy and statements to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["Official campaign-oriented account; claims about performance and national trajectory are unverified within the document."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d4768ce88582bb91","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In the same 7 October 2023 candidacy statement, Tshisekedi warned Congolese citizens against foreign influence and alleged that foreigners would manufacture candidates to speak to Congolese voters.","question_ids":["3B.3","4B.3","4B.6","7B.1"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; this is a documented political statement during the election period.","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency directly quotes Tshisekedi making the warning and allegation.","limitations":["The document supplies no evidence substantiating the alleged foreign manufacture of candidates or showing resulting harm."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7d654b5d9a34542a","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 22 December 2023, CENI issued a communiqué concerning the closure of voting across the national territory and in five pilot countries for the 2023 elections.","question_ids":["4B.1","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source records an election-administration event but not its quality or result.","ruler_attribution":"The communiqué is issued by CENI and does not attribute the closure decision to Tshisekedi personally.","limitations":["The supplied page contains only the communiqué title and publication information; no details on administration, irregularities, participation, or verification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c205ba8bf4f0adbf","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Constitutional Court's 9 January 2024 decision proclaimed the definitive results of the December 2023 presidential election, after which the court registry notified Tshisekedi and the notification constituted the final legal formality authorizing his inauguration.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The underlying election occurred in December 2023, but the court notification and legal authorization occurred in January 2024, outside the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The source describes a Constitutional Court and registry action, not a personal decision by Tshisekedi.","limitations":["Post-period source and official presidential account; it provides no independent assessment of electoral competitiveness or irregularities."]},{"source_id":"SRC-33906ffeb2b131d4","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"A November 2023 SIPRI fact sheet identified a convergence of climate change, environmental degradation, resource exploitation, and conflict dynamics in the DRC, warning that climate and green-transition pressures could deepen resource-management divisions and intercommunal conflict, while increasing livelihood and food insecurity and changing transhumance patterns.","question_ids":["2B.10","3B.6","3B.7","5B.9","6B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Published in November 2023 and directly describes risks facing the DRC during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The finding is SIPRI's institutional assessment, not an attribution of conduct or responsibility to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The supplied excerpt gives recommendations context but no evidence of Tshisekedi's response or implementation."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-7d654b5d9a34542a","SRC-7256161ad97961ca","SRC-9fba3a9477571455","SRC-c205ba8bf4f0adbf","SRC-3b87150544126584","SRC-694623af3b89fca8"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents are index pages, titles, or official summaries without substantive findings; they cannot support stronger claims about implementation, outcomes, accountability, or independent verification.","The supplied corpus contains limited direct evidence for 1B, 7B, and many institutional-performance lenses."]}
